= Dependency Epic Records

== Purpose

This directory holds the detailed records for paint-type's upstream dependency
epics. `DEPENDENCY-SCHEDULER.adoc` is the repository-level status index; these
files provide dependency-specific scope, acceptance criteria, and evidence.

== Contents

Files named `DEP-<number>-<dependency>.adoc` correspond to the stable dependency
identifiers in the scheduler.
